segments.title: A giant river runs through Cairo!
segments.say: Zahra from Cairo, Egypt, lives next to a giant river. Which one?

segments.title: Which river flows through Cairo?
segments.say: Which river flows through Cairo? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's the Nile!
segments.source: The Nile divides Cairo into east and west
segments.say: It's the Nile! One of the longest rivers in the world.

segments.title: The pyramids are nearby
segments.say: The pyramids of Giza stand on the Nile's west side.
